Healthcare Administration

Salve Regina University’s fully online Master’s of Healthcare Administration equips clinical and business professionals with the skills needed for innovative leadership in a rapidly changing health care industry. Ideal for clinicians and administrators seeking to advance their careers, the program examines the latest trends in business and health care while prioritizing the analytical competencies top organizations expect. The flexible curriculum lets you tailor coursework to your personal, professional, and educational goals.

Pricing

$16,260 total program cost — $542 per credit hour, plus $80/semester and $360 graduation fees.

Flexibility

Complete the program in as few as 18–24 months, with fall, spring and summer start dates available.

Benefits

Salve is approved for veterans’ benefits and named a Military Friendly School. Financial aid is available for eligible graduate students.

*Pricing reflects cost of MHA curriculum only

SALVE REGINA UNIVERSITY | MHA

Program Overview

Our online Master’s of Healthcare Administration is taught by faculty with real-world leadership experience in health care organizations. Through 10 courses delivered fully online, you’ll explore the complex landscape of the industry — from human resources management to health policy — and build the analytical and leadership competencies today’s organizations demand.

About Salve Regina

Founded by the Sisters of Mercy in 1934, Salve Regina University is a Catholic institution known for excellence in learning and fueling the imagination of students to bring forward progressive ideas that marry intellect and spiritual growth.

We enroll nearly 2,700 undergraduate and graduate students from across the globe. Our programs are designed to support a world that is harmonious, just and merciful by integrating student experience and personal values with competency in theory and in practice.

  • Financial aid is available
  • Join our program to discover the difference Salve can make in your personal and professional life
  • Opportunities for professional development within a holistic model of education backed by the Mercy Mission
  • Preparation to address future health needs of various populations

MHA Curriculum

Working toward your Master’s of Healthcare Administration inspires visionary leadership and empowers you to advance a just, equitable and compassionate health care system. Upon graduation, you will join a network of skilled professionals working in hospitals, health systems, physician practices, government agencies and nonprofit organizations.

Guided by Salve’s mercy mission, our program provides a values-driven curriculum designed to empower you to lead with courage in creating a just and ethical health care system. Ready to lead with purpose? Apply to Salve Regina University’s fully online MHA today.

Required Courses

HCA-501Introduction to Healthcare
HCA-509Human Resources Management
HCA-519Healthcare Finance
HCA-522Introduction to Healthcare Analytics
HCA-525Ethics for Health Professionals
HCA-528Health Policy
HCA-533Health Law
HCA-543Public Health Administration
HCA-547Application of Healthcare Management Theory

Plus 1 elective from available offerings — 10 courses / 36 credits total.

MHA Certifications

We also offer two online certificates:

  • Certificate of Graduate Studies – Healthcare Administration
  • Healthcare Leadership

Each is 4 courses (12 credits) drawn from the M.S. curriculum, so no credits are wasted if you continue to the full degree. Built for professionals who want continued development without committing to a full master’s program.
